reason: Declares Cloud route contexts and handler signatures. The agent Cloud routes dispatch the requests, and the Eliza Cloud plugin implements the handlers.
Declares the server state interface and transport records. createServerState creates the mutable record; server lifecycle, conversation and connector handlers change their respective fields.
Declares the route context and callback signatures. Workbench overview and VFS handlers use the context to read or update runtime state.
Declares hook event, configuration, discovery and status shapes. The hook loader installs handlers and the hook registry owns registration and dispatch.
Declares registry item and search result shapes. Registry client modules fetch, cache and project those records.
